note: AI-written TEST FIXTURES for local development, CI and PR previews only. Not reviewed content; the import endpoint refuses them in production.

senses.definition: A building where a person or family lives.

examples.text: Mi casa tiene un jardín pequeño.
examples.translation: My house has a small garden.

examples.text: Después de clase, voy a casa.
examples.translation: After class, I'm going home.

images.alt: A small house with a red roof, a door and two windows
images.source: Original drawing for LenguaLearn test fixtures

senses.definition: A common pet animal that barks.

examples.text: El perro de mi vecino ladra mucho.
examples.translation: My neighbor's dog barks a lot.

examples.text: Saco a pasear al perro cada mañana.
examples.translation: I take the dog for a walk every morning.

senses.definition: A person who studies at a school or university.

examples.text: La estudiante nueva se sienta a mi lado.
examples.translation: The new student sits next to me.

examples.text: Cada estudiante necesita un cuaderno.
examples.translation: Every student needs a notebook.

senses.definition: The clear liquid that falls as rain and that people drink.

examples.text: ¿Me das un vaso de agua, por favor?
examples.translation: Can you give me a glass of water, please?

examples.text: El agua del río está muy fría.
examples.translation: The river water is very cold.

senses.definition: A thin wooden tool with gray lead inside, used for writing.

examples.text: Necesito un lápiz para el examen.
examples.translation: I need a pencil for the exam.

examples.text: Mi lápiz no tiene punta.
examples.translation: My pencil doesn't have a point.

lemmas.formsNote: me quejo, te quejas, se queja

senses.definition: To say that you are unhappy or annoyed about something.

examples.text: Mi hermano siempre se queja de la comida.
examples.translation: My brother always complains about the food.

examples.text: No te quejes tanto.
examples.translation: Don't complain so much.

senses.definition: To own, hold or possess something.

examples.text: Tengo dos hermanos y una hermana.
examples.translation: I have two brothers and a sister.

examples.text: ¿Cuántos años tienes?
examples.translation: How old are you?

senses.definition: To move or travel from one place to another.

examples.text: Mañana vamos a la playa.
examples.translation: Tomorrow we're going to the beach.

examples.text: Ayer fui al cine con mis amigos.
examples.translation: Yesterday I went to the movies with my friends.

lemmas.formsNote: gran before a singular noun: un gran día

senses.definition: Of more than the usual size or amount.

examples.text: Vivimos en una ciudad muy grande.
examples.translation: We live in a very big city.

examples.text: Mi perro es grande pero muy tranquilo.
examples.translation: My dog is big but very calm.

senses.definition: Of less than the usual size or amount.

examples.text: Tengo un cuarto pequeño con una ventana.
examples.translation: I have a small room with a window.

examples.text: Cuando era pequeño, vivía en el campo.
examples.translation: When I was little, I lived in the countryside.

senses.definition: From Spain, or related to Spain or its language.

examples.text: Mi profesora es española, de Sevilla.
examples.translation: My teacher is Spanish, from Seville.

examples.text: Me gusta mucho la comida española.
examples.translation: I really like Spanish food.

senses.definition: A store that sells books.

examples.text: Compré este libro en la librería del centro.
examples.translation: I bought this book at the bookstore downtown.

examples.text: La librería cierra a las ocho.
examples.translation: The bookstore closes at eight.

senses.definition: A place where people can read or borrow books.

examples.text: Estudio en la biblioteca después de clase.
examples.translation: I study at the library after class.

examples.text: En la biblioteca hay que hablar en voz baja.
examples.translation: In the library you have to speak quietly.

senses.definition: A good result, or reaching what you wanted.

examples.text: La fiesta fue un éxito total.
examples.translation: The party was a total success.

examples.text: Te deseo mucho éxito en tu nuevo trabajo.
examples.translation: I wish you a lot of success in your new job.

senses.definition: Happening or existing now.

examples.text: La situación actual es difícil.
examples.translation: The current situation is difficult.

examples.text: El presidente actual vive en la capital.
examples.translation: The current president lives in the capital.

senses.definition: Having great value or effect.

examples.text: Es importante dormir bien antes de un examen.
examples.translation: It's important to sleep well before a test.

examples.text: Tengo una reunión muy importante mañana.
examples.translation: I have a very important meeting tomorrow.

senses.definition: A living creature that can move, such as a dog or a bird.

examples.text: Mi animal favorito es el caballo.
examples.translation: My favorite animal is the horse.

examples.text: El zoológico tiene más de cien animales.
examples.translation: The zoo has more than a hundred animals.

senses.definition: A place where sick or injured people get medical care.

examples.text: Mi madre trabaja en un hospital.
examples.translation: My mother works in a hospital.

examples.text: Llevaron al herido al hospital.
examples.translation: They took the injured man to the hospital.

senses.definition: A group of people related to each other, such as parents and children.

examples.text: Mi familia es muy grande.
examples.translation: My family is very big.

examples.text: Paso los domingos con mi familia.
examples.translation: I spend Sundays with my family.

senses.definition: The paper that shows how much you must pay at a restaurant or store.

examples.text: Disculpe, la cuenta, por favor.
examples.translation: Excuse me, the check, please.

examples.text: Pagamos la cuenta y salimos del restaurante.
examples.translation: We paid the bill and left the restaurant.

senses.definition: An arrangement to keep money in a bank, or to use a website.

examples.text: Abrí una cuenta en el banco.
examples.translation: I opened an account at the bank.

examples.text: Necesito la contraseña de mi cuenta.
examples.translation: I need the password for my account.

senses.definition: To do or complete a task, plan or activity.

examples.text: La escuela va a realizar una feria de ciencias.
examples.translation: The school is going to hold a science fair.

examples.text: Los científicos realizaron varios experimentos.
examples.translation: The scientists carried out several experiments.

lemmas.formsNote: me doy cuenta, te das cuenta; me di cuenta

senses.definition: To understand or notice something that you did not know before.

examples.text: De repente me di cuenta de que era tarde.
examples.translation: Suddenly I realized that it was late.

examples.text: ¿Te diste cuenta del error?
examples.translation: Did you notice the mistake?

senses.definition: So good or so strong that you cannot forget it.

examples.text: Fue un viaje inolvidable.
examples.translation: It was an unforgettable trip.

examples.text: Esa noche fue inolvidable para todos.
examples.translation: That night was unforgettable for everyone.

senses.definition: So necessary that you cannot do without it.

examples.text: El agua es imprescindible para la vida.
examples.translation: Water is essential for life.

examples.text: Un buen diccionario es imprescindible para traducir.
examples.translation: A good dictionary is essential for translating.

senses.definition: To reverse something that was done, such as a knot or a change.

examples.text: Voy a deshacer los cambios en el documento.
examples.translation: I'm going to undo the changes in the document.

examples.text: Ella deshizo el nudo con cuidado.
examples.translation: She undid the knot carefully.

senses.definition: To use a chance or a resource well.

examples.text: Hay que aprovechar el buen tiempo.
examples.translation: We have to make the most of the good weather.

examples.text: Aproveché el viaje para visitar a mi abuela.
examples.translation: I took advantage of the trip to visit my grandmother.

hooks.text: From provecho, “benefit”, which comes from Latin profectus, “progress”.

senses.definition: To have a relaxed conversation with someone.

examples.text: Nos gusta platicar después de comer.
examples.translation: We like to chat after eating.

examples.text: Ayer platiqué con mi tía por teléfono.
examples.translation: Yesterday I chatted with my aunt on the phone.

senses.definition: To ask for something in a formal way, often in writing.

examples.text: Quiero solicitar una beca para la universidad.
examples.translation: I want to apply for a scholarship for college.

examples.text: El cliente solicitó más información.
examples.translation: The customer requested more information.

senses.definition: To get hold of something, to use transport, or to drink.

examples.text: Siempre tomo el autobús para ir a la escuela.
examples.translation: I always take the bus to go to school.

examples.text: ¿Quieres tomar un café?
examples.translation: Do you want to have a coffee?

senses.definition: A choice that you make after thinking about it.

examples.text: Fue una decisión muy difícil.
examples.translation: It was a very difficult decision.

examples.text: Tenemos que tomar una decisión hoy.
examples.translation: We have to make a decision today.

senses.definition: To do the first part of something.

examples.text: La clase empieza a las ocho.
examples.translation: Class starts at eight.

examples.text: Mañana empiezo un trabajo nuevo.
examples.translation: Tomorrow I start a new job.

senses.definition: To do the first part of something.

examples.text: El partido va a comenzar pronto.
examples.translation: The game is going to start soon.

examples.text: La película comenzó tarde.
examples.translation: The movie started late.

senses.definition: To move something so that it is no longer closed.

examples.text: ¿Puedes abrir la ventana?
examples.translation: Can you open the window?

examples.text: La tienda abre a las nueve.
examples.translation: The store opens at nine.

senses.definition: To move something so that it is no longer open.

examples.text: Por favor, cierra la puerta.
examples.translation: Please close the door.

examples.text: El banco cierra a las tres.
examples.translation: The bank closes at three.

senses.definition: Coins and bills that people use to buy things.

examples.text: No tengo dinero para el cine.
examples.translation: I don't have money for the movies.

examples.text: Ahorro dinero para comprar una bicicleta.
examples.translation: I'm saving money to buy a bicycle.

hooks.text: Mnemonic: you need dinero to pay for dinner.

senses.definition: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs.

examples.text: Pon los platos en la mesa.
examples.translation: Put the plates on the table.

examples.text: La mesa de la cocina es de madera.
examples.translation: The kitchen table is made of wood.

hooks.text: Mnemonic: picture a messy table covered in books.

senses.definition: A boy or man who has the same parents as you.

examples.text: Mi hermano mayor estudia medicina.
examples.translation: My older brother studies medicine.

examples.text: Juego al fútbol con mi hermano.
examples.translation: I play soccer with my brother.

senses.definition: Moving or happening at high speed.

examples.text: Mi hermano es muy rápido en las carreras.
examples.translation: My brother is very fast in races.

examples.text: El tren rápido llega en una hora.
examples.translation: The fast train arrives in an hour.

senses.definition: In a good or correct way.

examples.text: Hoy me siento muy bien.
examples.translation: I feel very good today.

examples.text: Ella canta muy bien.
examples.translation: She sings very well.

senses.definition: Used to say that you really want something to happen.

examples.text: Ojalá haga sol mañana.
examples.translation: I hope it's sunny tomorrow.

examples.text: Ojalá que ganemos el partido.
examples.translation: Hopefully we win the game.

hooks.text: From Andalusian Arabic law šá lláh, “if God wills”.
